posts.headline: Draft's over, rosters are locked, and One Nut Barner's 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and STILL zero rings is now the longest-running crime scene in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: Six straight editions of this column and Put it in Ra hasn't uttered a word — the résumé is loudest thing in the room, the trophy case stays empty.

posts.headline: Draft night is officially in the books, and Big Head has run out of editions to explain how a title banner hangs over a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World has a ring, sure, but a 5.5 average finish says that title was a fluke waiting to happen again — prove it on the field this time, Megamind.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh enters the season still owning the single worst résumé in the league, and a completed draft doesn't erase a 4-10 record and dead-last 12th-place finish.
posts.detail: The untalented tenth needed a war room miracle in that draft — until Week 1 proves otherwise, this is still the basement of Busters Anonymous.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT heads into the season with the Ultimate Light Skin still carrying the sin of drafting a DEFENSIVE player first overall — this league doesn't grant absolution that easily.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record and 5.5 average finish means Eli's preaching about the belt while his roster history reads like a plague waiting to happen.

posts.headline: Thicks and the #FreeMaxx Champions open title defense with a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish that says the ring, not the résumé, has carried this dynasty for two straight seasons.
posts.detail: Draft's done, excuses are gone — Week 1 is where we finally find out if the reigning champs are built different or just got lucky once.
